done_when: The runtime dependency tree resolves the flagged body-parser and Zod copies to patched releases without breaking schema, MCP or sandbox behavior; the rebuilt runtime image passes the unchanged high and critical Trivy scan and existing PR checks

findings.body: The supplied proof records a main-CI failure during sandbox loopback setup. It also says this follow-up preserves the real sandbox executable body, runner and permissions; the added diagnostics only observe failures. Thus the known enforcement failure remains unresolved, and passing schema tests, namespace probes and the image check does not demonstrate protected-file enforcement. Fix the sandbox execution failure while preserving the real assertions, then obtain a passing enforcement check. This finding concerns the recorded failure, not merely the pending diagnostic results.
findings.title: Not done: sandbox execution and protected-file enforcement

why: The runtime image is blocked by body-parser and Zod security findings
